title: Across bridge position
description: A bridge between two named accounts of the strategy through one named Across market. The account sends on the market's chain; the destination account receives on the market's destination chain. One allocation per source account and sent asset. The source account is an EOA.

account.description: The named account that sends, on the market's chain.

destination_account.description: The named account that receives, on the market's destination chain. Another account than the sender.

capital.description: Optional amount of the sent asset the allocation starts with. The funding statement requires it before the first bridge. It is not a limit: how much to bridge is the strategy's decision. Defaults to zero.

minimum_native_balance.description: Native balance the source account's gas payer keeps, on the source chain.
